messages:
Alex Kim: Quick heads-up — going to propose a small launch plan for the OpenRef demo + tutorial bundle. Goal: get community use + collect evs/benchmarks. :rocket:
Maria Chen: love it. what's the minimal launch? blog post + 1 tutorial + 1 reference app?
Alex Kim: yep. blog (announce + benchmark highlights), 1 interactive tutorial (Cloud + local), refapp repo with sample workflows, and a short webinar.
Priya Singh: agree. recommend we lead with a cost/latency benchmark vs baseline model for the blog — short, reproducible. can we reuse the `micro-bench` harness?
Tom B.: we can. I'll fork the harness and add a simplified runbook. Plan: 3-run median, include command and seed. e.g.:
```
git clone git@github.com:redwood/openref.git
cd openref/bench
./run_bench.sh --model xr-2 --seq 512
```
Maria Chen: nice. CTA in blog should push to refapp repo + tutorial sign-up. Use UTM: utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=openref_launch
Alex Kim: webinar slot? 2 weeks out, 45 min: 20m demo, 15m bench & best practices, 10m Q&A. Priya lead demo, Tom does bench section, I do opening + close.
Priya Singh: works for me. I'll draft slides + a short notebook walkthrough. need a sample prompt set and a small eval checklist.
Tom B.: I'll output a one-page reproducibility checklist and upload artifacts (logs + CSV). Also add a `results/` folder in the repo.
DevRel Bot: Reminder: schedule webinar page once assets are ready. Use calendar link generator: https://meet.redwood.ai/schedule
Maria Chen: inbound flow — blog CTA should create a lead in HubSpot with tag `openref_launch`. Also set nurture drip: 3 emails (intro, how-to, case study). Assign to marketing-devcontent queue.
Alex Kim: agree. Priya, can you share draft tutorial by EOD Fri? Maria, can you draft the blog outline by Monday? Tom, bench artifacts by Monday too?
Priya Singh: yes — tutorial draft by Fri. Will include interactive Binder link + local docker steps.
Maria Chen: I'll post outline Monday morning and ping for a quick review.
Tom B.: bench artifacts by Monday noon. I'll also add a small README for how to adapt to other models.
Alex Kim: Perfect. Final checklist before publish: blog post, refapp repo public, tutorial live in docs site, webinar page up, hubspot flow wired, tracking UTMs, and a measuring plan. Who owns publish day? Maria takes blog + email, Priya + Tom verify repos/docs.
Maria Chen: I can own publish day ops. Will create PR in content repo for scheduled publish.
Priya Singh: I'll do a final pass on tutorial and confirm Binder runs.
Tom B.: I'll sanity-check bench numbers once CI runs through.
Alex Kim: OK team — tentative publish date = 2024-05-08. If anything slips, call it out here. :thumbsup: 
Maria Chen: noted. I'll block the date on the calendar and create the HubSpot assets template.
DevRel Bot: Event created: OpenRef demo webinar — 2024-05-09 17:00 UTC (placeholder). Update when confirmed.
Alex Kim: small marketing ask — short hero GIF showing refapp in action for social posts. Priya can we grab a 20s capture?
Priya Singh: yep I'll export a 20s GIF and a 1:1 screenshot pack for socials.
Maria Chen: thanks — will draft copy for social and email after I see GIF.
Alex Kim: Awesome. Closing: action items recapped in thread — will convert to linear checklist in Notion and share.
Maria Chen: thx all!
Priya Singh: excited to ship.
Tom B.: :+1:
